notes.title: New Feature Update: Take Control!
notes.content:
This FREE update adds the long-promised ability to rename CPU drivers and teams, as well as a couple of bonus features such as manual gears and traction control, and a bunch of smaller improvements and fixes. Here is what is included :-

*ADDED The ability to rename CPU drivers and CPU teams. 
*ADDED An option to switch to using manual gears.
*ADDED An option to adjust the amount of traction control the player’s car uses. 
*ADDED An option to give all game characters large eyes. 
*ADDED The ability to skip the tutorial if the player has a saved profile already. 
*IMPROVED Camera occlusion on various tracks when using BLIMP camera view.
*IMPROVED Screen layouts for ultra-wide displays. 
*IMPROVED More intelligent CPU overtaking behaviour.
*FIXED The sound of the engine blowing up on elimination race, does not respect volume settings.
*FIXED Moving from CHAMPIONSHIP to HOT LAP on the Mode Select Screen without moving over CAREER causes the screen scene to offset. 
*FIXED The Caspian Sea time trial loading the wrong track variant. 
*FIXED Game stats appearing in miles when kilometres selected.
*FIXED Starting a race in cockpit view starts the camera inside the character’s head before zooming out. 
*FIXED Track-side speed signs not acting as physics objects.  
*FIXED Season cups readout not displaying correctly.
*FIXED Player’s car sometimes appearing on track instead of in the pits when choosing race strategy.
*FIXED CPU cars sometimes being upside down on track shortly after a race start.
*FIXED The player’s car exiting the pits sometimes starts stationary rather than at pit speed.
*FIXED Incorrect language on the Valencia track run off.
*FIXED New profile saves incorrectly remember the player’s racing line setting.
*FIXED No rewind button in the tutorial when returning from CHAMPIONSHIP MODE. 
*FIXED Changing decades just before a change of globe location could prevent progress. 
*FIXED Phone calls from blank character meshes. 
*FIXED New season title card displaying “season 0” rather than “season 1”.
*FIXED Driver overalls in CHAMPIONSHIP MODE not matching car livery.
*FIXED Audio levels and other settings not saving properly. 
*FIXED Temporary profiles being created when profiles deleted. 

(To change driver or team names, or change the logos of the teams, follow these steps):
1. Go to New Star GP in your Steam Library
2. Click on the cog or right click on the name of the game in the list and select Manage > Browse Local Files
3. The CustomData.txt template file is in the "release" subfolder.
4. Follow the instructions in that file and save the edited version OUTSIDE the "release" subfolder, along with any custom logos you want the game to use. This protects your changes from being overwritten by Steam's file validation.
That’s it!

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
This update adds a couple of features asked for by the community, along with inprovements and bug fixes. Full list follows:- 

- ADDED: Some steering wheel support. Support for Logitech G29 and Thrustmaster T150 models. A couple of caveats: there’s no force feedback and the game may display incorrect button iconography in the UI based on the wheel model you own. 
- ADDED: MPH/KPH toggle via settings menu
- IMPROVED: Rendering performance in races
- IMPROVED: CPU optimisation in races
- IMPROVED: Messaging around replaying or attempting to replay GPs
- IMPROVED: Translations
- FIXED: Incorrect keyboard steering when mouse steer is enabled.
- FIXED: Incorrect track loading after a pre-race phone call or dilemma.
- FIXED: Decal positioning on some car bodies
- FIXED: Incorrect instructions on Brisbane 2020 GP
- FIXED: Missing characters in some languages
- FIXED: Season reset button visibility logic
- FIXED: Visual behaviour of leaderboard when resetting season
- FIXED: Occasional progression blockers caused by the RPG waterfalls
- FIXED: Grass showing through curbs on certain tracks
- FIXED: Erroneous split time when in last place
- FIXED: Entering a race with a maxed out car and leased technology causing non-progression
- FIXED: Losing one or both wings now counts as a component failure towards achievements.
- FIXED: Occasional UI misbehaviour on the Profile Screen
- FIXED: MP Leaderboard button states and general appearance

If you have any problems with the update, please let us know on discord or email us using support@newstargames.com. Thanks.

notes.title: Creation Mode Update
notes.content:
CREATION MODE UPDATE

* ADDED: Create-a-Championship Mode. This mode offers players the ability to create their own custom championship competitions. A host of options are available for tweaking, such as track length, pitting, or weather; and in the advanced options, settings such as race speed, how competitive the CPU opponents are, and the option to carry car damage over between races allows players to customise the experience to their own tastes. The requests for longer race durations have been answered with the option to set race distance (99 lap races anyone?), and to top it off, any custom competitions can be played in either single player, or multiplayer with up to four players.
* ADDED: Staff personalities. Staff now have different personalities: some are easy to keep happy, others less so. Some upset other staff members, others don’t, while some also have special bonus abilities, so choosing between members of staff based on their personalities offers more strategy options for your team and more depth and richness between races. Additionally, staff happiness now offers a bonus to perk performance, so keeping your staff happy is worth the effort as it gains you an edge on the track. 
* ADDED: Some extra staff-related news stories based on their personalities.
* ADDED: A few extra character customisation options.  
* FIXED: Bug where a failure could occur in non-GP races without a warning dilemma.
* FIXED: Title screen crash if more than four controllers are connected. 
* FIXED: Incompatibility problem with save game formats.

notes.title: Patch Notes 20/9/2023 (Build 12227691)
notes.content:
*IMPROVED: Significant optimisations to in-race code and rendering to wring the most out of your playing device
*IMPROVED: Track abrasion settings. We’ve updated the track abrasion settings in PRO DIFFICULTY only, reducing the durability of soft and hard tyres to better differentiate between pit strategies. 
*IMPROVED: Tyre wear upgrade now has a more significant effect
*IMPROVED: New values for Time Trial and Checkpoint events in PRO DIFFICULTY making those events more challenging and more in line with the rest of the events in PRO DIFFICULTY. 
*IMPROVED: Reduced level of boost in PRO DIFFICULTY only to about half its previous effect. 
*FIXED: The wrong times were being reported at the end of Elimination events. 
*FIXED: When deleting a save slot, the selected save slot now stays selected. 
*FIXED: Removed the problem with wet tyres overly wearing during rain showers.
*FIXED: Triggering a rewind during a tutorial message caused the game to enter a state from which it could not progress. 
*FIXED: Incorrect button icons being displayed on Steam Deck for resetting a car pointing in the wrong direction.
*FIXED: No more pesky keyboard prompts on Steam Deck. 
*FIXED: Unlocked perk slots now show correct unlocked colouring. 
*FIXED: Braking SFX no longer ducks the game music.
*FIXED: Player car bouncing and skewing sideways when leaving the pits for the second time.
*FIXED: No icon being displayed on the CONTINUE button of the “not using staff perks” phone message.  
*FIXED: It was possible to get invites to rival races in decades that were not accessible in-game.  
*FIXED: When racing in CHAMPIONSHIP MODE, the track maps have been scaled so they no longer obscure split times. 
*FIXED: Personal best UI animation now timed correctly. 
*FIXED: Completing or cancelling a championship now correctly resets progress.

notes.title: Patch Notes 22/8/2023 (Build 12003666)
notes.content:
* ADDED: Pro difficulty mode for new careers! Something for more experienced racers to get their teeth into right from the 80s.
* IMPROVED: Warm tyres perk is more effective and all rolling start events begin with warm tyres.
* IMPROVED: Staff happiness easier to sustain - further RPG changes are in the pipeline.
* IMPROVED: Added a chicane to the Naples short track
* IMPROVED: Variability of race outcome for the middle grid places.
* UPDATED: Wet tyres now degrade substantially quicker on dry tracks
* FIXED: Reset button on the Season Leaderboard screen no longer leaves you unable to complete a season. Clicking the button now will unblock affected saves.
* FIXED: Closed loophole in AI logic that caused them to steer into you if you approached their rear tyre
* FIXED: Incorrectly awarded bodyshell in the 90s
* FIXED: Full-length track warning appearing too often
* FIXED: AI cars were choosing splash-n-dash last lap pit strategies far too often.
